<style>
/* --- 반응형 CSS (Mobile First) --- */
:root {
    --bg-color: #e9ecef; /* 눈부심 방지 */
    --main-color: #0b1b34; 
    --point-color: #E53935; 
    --text-color: #333;
    --light-text: #777;
    --border-color: #ddd;
    --box-bg: #fff;
    --max-width: 1050px; /* 정보 밀도 강화 */
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body { font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', '맑은 고딕', AppleSDGothicNeo-Regular, sans-serif; background-color: var(--bg-color); color: var(--text-color); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; }
a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: color 0.2s; }
a:hover { color: var(--point-color); }
ul { list-style: none; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }

.main-wrapper { 
    width: 100%; 
    max-width: var(--max-width); 
    margin: 0 auto; 
    background-color: var(--box-bg); 
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); 
    padding-bottom: 30px; 
    border-left: 1px solid #ddd;
    border-right: 1px solid #ddd;
}

.header { background-color: var(--main-color); color: #fff; padding: 15px 20px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.header .logo a { font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -1px; }
.header .user-menu { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 13px; }
.header .user-menu a.login-btn, .header .user-menu a.logout-btn { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
.header .user-menu a.login-btn:hover { background-color: #fff; color: var(--main-color); }

.nav { background-color: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1000; }
.nav-list { display: flex; width: 100%; justify-content: space-around; max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; }
.nav-list li a { display: block; padding: 15px 10px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; text-align: center; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; }
.nav-list li a:hover, .nav-list li a.active { border-bottom-color: var(--main-color); color: var(--main-color); }

.container { padding: 10px; }
.section { margin-bottom: 35px; padding: 15px 10px; border-radius: 8px; }

.section:nth-of-type(odd) { background-color: #fafafa; }

.section-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--main-color); padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
.section-header h2 { font-size: 20px; color: var(--main-color); font-weight: bold; }
.section-header h2 a:hover { color: inherit; }
.section-header .more-btn { font-size: 13px; color: var(--light-text); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 4px; background: #f9f9f9;}

/* 인피드 광고 영역 */
.in-feed-ad { 
    margin: 25px auto; 
    padding: 10px 0;
    text-align: center; 
    overflow: hidden; 
    width: 100%; 
    position: relative;
}

.in-feed-ad ins { display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; }

/* Swiper 공통 */
.content-swiper { width: 100%; position: relative; padding-bottom: 35px; } 
.content-swiper .swiper-slide { display: flex; justify-content: center; min-height: 150px; }
.content-swiper .loading-indicator { font-size: 14px; color: var(--light-text); padding: 50px 0; }

.slide-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 15px 10px; width: 100%; }
.mobile-swiper .slide-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px 8px; }

@media (min-width: 600px) {
    .slide-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px 15px; }
    .mobile-swiper .slide-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
    .nav-list li a { padding: 15px 20px; font-size: 17px; }
}
@media (min-width: 900px) {
    .slide-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); } 
    .mobile-swiper .slide-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); }
    .section-header h2 { font-size: 22px; }
}

.item-box { width: 100%; text-align: center; }
.item-box .thumb-link { display: block; position: relative; width: 100%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 6px; background-color: #eee; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.latest-news-swiper .thumb-link, .new-release-swiper .thumb-link, .pc-swiper .thumb-link, .online-swiper .thumb-link { padding-top: 75%; }
.mobile-swiper .thumb-link { padding-top: 133.33%; }
.item-box .thumb-link img { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.item-box .title-link { display: block; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; color: #333; margin-top: 5px; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; padding: 0 2px; }
.item-box font.genre, .item-box .genre-text { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--light-text); margin-top: 3px; }
.new-label { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; background-color: var(--point-color); padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; margin-left: 4px; vertical-align: middle; }

.content-swiper .swiper-pagination { bottom: 0; }
.content-swiper .swiper-pagination-bullet { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #ccc; opacity: 1; margin: 0 4px !important; }
.content-swiper .swiper-pagination-bullet-active { background: var(--main-color); width: 18px; border-radius: 4px; } 

.news-text-list { margin-top: 15px; background-color: #f1f3f5; padding: 15px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e9ecef; }
.news-text-item { margin-bottom: 7px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #dee2e6; padding-bottom: 7px; font-size: 15px; }
.news-text-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
.news-text-item a { display: block; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; color: #495057; }
.news-text-item .icon { color: var(--main-color); margin-right: 5px; font-size: 11px; }

.footer { background-color: var(--main-color); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); text-align: center; padding: 40px 20px; font-size: 13px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
.footer strong { color: #fff; }
.footer-links { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.footer-links a { margin: 0 10px; color: #fff; }
.logo-menu-wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
    min-width: 0;
}

.top-recommend-menu {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.top-recommend-menu a {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

.top-recommend-menu a:hover {
    color: #ffca28;
}

.top-recommend-menu span {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    font-size: 11px;
}
.side-ad-right { 
    display: none; 
}

@media (min-width: 1500px) {
    .side-ad-right {
        display: block;
        position: fixed;
        top: 110px;
        width: 300px;
        height: 600px;
        z-index: 999;
        left: 50%;
        margin-left: 545px;
        border: 1px solid #ddd;
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: 2px 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
        overflow: hidden;
    }
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

    function setupAjaxSwiper(swiperConfig) {
        const { containerSelector, wrapperId, paginationClass, totalPages, ajaxEndpoint } = swiperConfig;
        const wrapper = document.getElementById(wrapperId);
        const swiperContainer = document.querySelector(containerSelector);

        if (!wrapper || !swiperContainer) return;

        const slidesData = new Array(totalPages).fill(null);
        let swiperInstance = null;

        function initializeSwiper() {
            swiperInstance = new Swiper(swiperContainer, {
                slidesPerView: 1, slidesPerGroup: 1, spaceBetween: 10,
                pagination: { el: paginationClass, clickable: true },
                on: {
                    slideChange: function () { loadSlideContent(this.activeIndex); },
                    init: function() { loadSlideContent(this.activeIndex); }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadSlideContent(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= totalPages || slidesData[index] !== null) return;
            const page = index + 1;
            const targetSlideElement = wrapper.children[index];
            if (!targetSlideElement) return;

            targetSlideElement.innerHTML = '<div class="loading-indicator">로딩 중...</div>';
            slidesData[index] = 'loading';

            fetch(`${ajaxEndpoint}?page=${page}`)
                .then(response => response.ok ? response.text() : Promise.reject(response))
                .then(html => {
                    if (html.trim() === "") {
                        targetSlideElement.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 30px; text-align:center; font-size:13px; color:#999;">정보가 없습니다.</div>';
                        slidesData[index] = 'empty';
                    } else {
                        const inner = document.createElement('div');
                        inner.classList.add('slide-inner');
                        inner.innerHTML = html;
                        targetSlideElement.innerHTML = '';
                        targetSlideElement.appendChild(inner);
                        slidesData[index] = 'loaded';
                    }
                })
                .catch(() => {
                    targetSlideElement.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 30px; text-align:center; color:red; font-size:13px;">오류 발생</div>';
                    slidesData[index] = 'error';
                });
        }

        function createEmptySlides() {
            wrapper.innerHTML = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < totalPages; i++) {
                const slide = document.createElement('div');
                slide.classList.add('swiper-slide');
                wrapper.appendChild(slide);
            }
            initializeSwiper();
        }

        if (totalPages > 0) createEmptySlides();
    }

    setupAjaxSwiper({ containerSelector: '.latest-news-swiper', wrapperId: 'latest-news-slide-wrapper', paginationClass: '.latest-news-swiper .swiper-pagination', totalPages: 10, ajaxEndpoint: 'load_latest_news_ajax.php' });
    setupAjaxSwiper({ containerSelector: '.new-release-swiper', wrapperId: 'new-release-slide-wrapper', paginationClass: '.new-release-swiper .swiper-pagination', totalPages: 10, ajaxEndpoint: 'load_new_release_ajax.php' });
    setupAjaxSwiper({ containerSelector: '.mobile-swiper', wrapperId: 'mobile-slide-wrapper', paginationClass: '.mobile-swiper .swiper-pagination', totalPages: 10, ajaxEndpoint: 'load_mobile_game_ajax.php' });
    setupAjaxSwiper({ containerSelector: '.pc-swiper', wrapperId: 'pc-slide-wrapper', paginationClass: '.pc-swiper .swiper-pagination', totalPages: 10, ajaxEndpoint: 'load_pc_game_ajax.php' });
    setupAjaxSwiper({ containerSelector: '.online-swiper', wrapperId: 'online-slide-wrapper', paginationClass: '.online-swiper .swiper-pagination', totalPages: 10, ajaxEndpoint: 'load_online_game_ajax.php' });
});
</script>
